narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Two framework design axioms live **only** in `main.md` and are unreachable from the agent entry surfaces. Agents that work from `AGENTS.md` or from a dispatch preamble never see them, and re-derive the principle from scratch every time.

- `main.md` `## Rule Authority [AXIOM]` — deterministic > Taskfile > xBRIEF > RFC2119 > prose
- `main.md` `## Thin Fail-Closed Design (#3265)` — one fail-closed deterministic check + one remediation string; thin closable slices

## Evidence

A repo search for Thin Fail-Closed and Rule Authority found those strings in main.md and supporting docs, not in the three agent entry surfaces.

Neither string appears in any of the three agent entry surfaces:

| Surface | Rule Authority | #3265 |
|---|---|---|
| root `AGENTS.md` (managed + unmanaged) | absent | absent |
| `content/templates/agents-entry.md` (consumer managed block) | absent | absent |
| `content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md` (dispatched workers) | absent | absent |

The preamble already demonstrates the pattern it is missing: line 535 cites `main.md ## Dual Stop Rule (#2442)` by name. Dispatched workers therefore inherit the dual-stop axiom and not the determinism one.

Not a regression: #3269 landed #3265 as `docs(main)` only, so propagation was never in scope.

## Observed failure

On #3310 (duplicate-candidate disposition), multiple evaluation passes independently re-derived "prefer a thin deterministic check over skill prose" and then proposed promoting an issue-scoped design choice to **axiom** tier — while `## Thin Fail-Closed Design (#3265)` and the Rule Authority ladder already said exactly that, and `decision:write` (#1396) was the correct home for the local choice. The passes that missed it were working from AGENTS.md / preamble context; the pass that applied #3265 unprompted had read `main.md` via session routing.

Cost of the gap: re-derivation tokens on every design thread, plus a live attempt to inflate a feature decision to constitution tier (which #3164 exists to prevent).

## Consumer relevance (why this is not maintainer-only)

- **Rule Authority** — consumers author project rules constantly. The ladder is what tells them to encode a rule as a `task` check instead of prose in their AGENTS.md. Already treated as framework-wide in ADR-001 / SPECIFICATION / philosophy.
- **#3265** — the underlying pattern (close a process gap with one deterministic check + one remediation string, not a doc) applies to any consumer with `task deft:check`, hooks, or their own verifies. The main.md wording names framework-internal surfaces (release preflight, SkillOpt / #2436), so the consumer-facing pointer MUST be a surface-neutral restatement, not a copy-paste.

Precedent for a dual-audience axiom: #709 (`Repair Authority [AXIOM]` — "for consumers and maintainers").

## Proposed fix (thin, pointer-sufficient — dogfoods #3265)

The agents-entry contract is **pointer-sufficient** since #2371 / #2457, so this is one line per rule, not a mirror:

1. Add a compressed pointer for each rule to `content/templates/agents-entry.md`, surface-neutral wording (`task deft:*` form for consumers).
2. Add the two headers to `PROPAGATION_HEADER_MARKERS` in `packages/core/src/content-contracts/skills/agents_entry_contract.test.ts` so the propagation is gated rather than aspirational.
3. Add a one-line citation to `content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md` in the same style as the existing Dual Stop line (535).
4. `task agents:refresh` to propagate into the managed AGENTS.md block.

Explicit non-goal: copying the main.md bodies into any entry surface. #865 (every rule is a token tax) is the live counterweight — pointer-sufficient is what keeps this affordable.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `agents-entry.md` carries a pointer for Rule Authority and for #3265, surface-neutral for consumers
- [ ] `agents_entry_contract.test.ts` marker list gates both, so removal fails a test
- [ ] `agent-prompt-preamble.md` cites both by `main.md` section name, matching the Dual Stop precedent
- [ ] Managed AGENTS.md block regenerated via `task agents:refresh`
- [ ] No main.md body text duplicated into any entry surface (pointer-sufficient only)
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated

## Cross-links

- #3269 — landed #3265 in main.md (`docs(main)`); propagation out of scope there
- #1309 — template propagation discipline: consumer-relevant maintainer rules MUST mirror into `agents-entry.md`
- #2371 / #2457 — pointer-sufficient inversion of the agents-entry contract
- #2316 — open: add a **preamble propagation contract gate**; the mechanism for AC 3 likely belongs there, this issue supplies the content
- #865 — every-rule-is-a-token-tax (counterweight; why pointer-sufficient)
- #709 — `Repair Authority [AXIOM]` precedent for consumer+maintainer axiom scope
- #3310 — the thread where the gap surfaced
